chunks: From him, from Abū Yaḥyā al-Wāsiṭī, from some of his companions, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Does the junub rinse his mouth and draw water into his nose? He said: No; it is only the exterior that becomes junub.

key_terms.الظَّاهِرُ: the outward or external part of the body
key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.لَا: an explicit negation indicating the ruling is no

ai.seo_question: Is a junub required to rinse the mouth and nose during ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the junub and whether rinsing the mouth and nose is required. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that it is not required, indicating that janabah pertains to the outward state in this context.
